text:
Anya K: Quick sync — planning a routing/traffic shift for staging edges in eu & apac tonight at 02:00 UTC. Goal is to validate the new preferring-policy for low-latency routing. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks?
Matt S: I can drive the rollout. Plan: weighted DNS shift 0->20->60->100 with 5m soak between steps. Will run smoke tests after each step and watch traces.
Ryan P: Thumbs up. Are we using Route53 weighted records or our edge-router weight policy? Also confirm TTL — low (60s) for quick rollback?
Anya K: Using Route53 weighted records for this staging run. TTL set to 60s. Rollback plan is immediate revert weights + clear cache if needed.
Matt S: Smoke checklist (will run after each step):
- curl health endpoint (expect 200)
- 5 sample generation prompts, verify no regressions in token output
- 95th p90 latency <200ms for staging traffic profile
- error-rate <1% over 1m
I'll post results in thread per step.
Sylvia M: I'll own the rollback script and monitor SLO dashboards. Rollback command is `./scripts/rollback-edge.sh eu` (and `apac`). Keep me tagged.
Anya K: Thanks — tagging deploy-bot to add the calendar entry and remind on the hour. Also Matt, leave the canary at 20% for at least 5m unless you see a blocker.
deploy-bot: Deployment window added: 2026-06-12 02:00 UTC — Reminder 30m before.
Ryan P: Quick prechecks I'll run before handoff:
1) confirm route53 record weights are editable via our infra role
2) ensure monitor alerts for 5xx and latency are enabled
3) verify we have a warm fallback region with 0 weight but healthy endpoints
Matt S: Prechecks done: infra role OK, alerts on, fallback healthy. Starting step 1 at 02:00 UTC. I'll post step completions here.
Anya K: Perfect. If rollout looks flaky, revert to 0 weight immediately and escalate. Otherwise, after 100% confirm, we'll run a short load test to exercise autoscale. :thumbsup:
